This plot is my yam ground, and yam needs good soil to make big tubers. I will put some fertilizer because the land has been worked before, but not too much — yam does not take plenty fertilizer like maize. I will also spread manure from the animals around the house. The seed I will use is from last year's harvest, the setts I kept; improved seed for yam is not easy to find in our market. Labor is the big work — mounding, staking, and weeding take time, so my wife and children will help, and I will hire some young men for the mounding.
